    Assets

    How the numbers work. Interest compounds monthly at your APR ÷ 12, and payments, contributions and growth land on the same day each month. Between payments the clock slides smoothly from one month's balance to the next. Asset growth uses the rate you enter, which real markets won't follow exactly. These are estimates to help you see the path, not financial advice.

    No accounts and no bank linking. Everything you type stays in this browser. Unlocking Pro sends only your license key to Lemon Squeezy to confirm it; your numbers never leave this page.
